46537-mildred-at-roselands-a-sequel-to-m.title: And Other Popular Books
46537-mildred-at-roselands-a-sequel-to-m.creator: Martha Finley
46537-mildred-at-roselands-a-sequel-to-m.description: A book by Martha Finley. My story may seem to end somewhat abruptly; but is to be continued in a future volume. The date of this tale is about four years earlier than that of Elsie Dinsmore--the first of the Elsie Series--and any one who cares to know more of the little heiress of Viamede, will find the narrative of her life carried on in those books.

68346-england-under-the-angevin-kings-vo.title: The Angevin Kings
68346-england-under-the-angevin-kings-vo.creator: Kate Norgate
68346-england-under-the-angevin-kings-vo.description: A book by Kate Norgate. “When the green tree, cut asunder in the midst and severed by the space of three furlongs, shall be grafted in again and shall bring forth flowers and fruit,--then at last may England hope to see the end of her sorrows.”[1]

arxiv-2109-12574.title: The extraordinary frequency pattern variation in δ \delta Scuti stars
arxiv-2109-12574.creator: L. A. Balona
arxiv-2109-12574.description: Abstract Inspection of the periodograms of TESS δ \delta Scuti stars indicates that there is little, if any, similarity between the frequencies of stars in the same region of the H–R diagram. This is difficult to understand because pulsation models predict that stars with similar physical parameters should have similar frequencies.

arxiv-2204-12068.title: Improved AI-generated Solar Farside Magnetograms by STEREO and SDO Data Sets and Their Release PyTorch ( Paszke et al. 2019 ) , NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , Astropy ( Robitaille et al. 2013 ; Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) , SunPy ( The Sun
arxiv-2204-12068.creator: Hyun-Jin Jeong, Yong-Jae Moon, Eunsu Park, Harim Lee, Ji-Hye Baek
arxiv-2204-12068.description: Abstract Here we greatly improve Artificial Intelligence (AI)-generated solar farside magnetograms using data sets of Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory (STEREO) and Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). We modify our previous deep learning model and configuration of input data sets to generate more realistic magnetograms than before.

arxiv-2304-08826.title: Perceive, Excavate and Purify: A Novel Object Mining Framework for Instance Segmentation
arxiv-2304-08826.creator: Jinming Su, Ruihong Yin, Xingyue Chen, Junfeng Luo
arxiv-2304-08826.description: Abstract Recently, instance segmentation has made great progress with the rapid development of deep neural networks. However, there still exist two main challenges including discovering indistinguishable objects and modeling the relationship between instances. To deal with these difficulties, we propose a novel object mining framework for instance segmentation.

arxiv-2308-12120.title: An Open-Source ML-Based Full-Stack Optimization Framework for Machine Learning Accelerators CCS: Hardware Physical design (EDA) CCS: Hardware Hardware accelerators CCS: Hardware Application specific integrated circuits
arxiv-2308-12120.creator: Hadi Esmaeilzadeh, Soroush Ghodrati, Andrew B. Kahng, Joon Kyung Kim, Sean Kinzer, Sayak Kundu, Rohan Mahapatra, Susmita Dey Manasi, Sachin S. Sapatnekar, Zhiang Wang, Ziqing Zeng
arxiv-2308-12120.description: Abstract . Parameterizable machine learning (ML) accelerators are the product of recent breakthroughs in ML. To fully enable their design space exploration (DSE), we propose a physical-design-driven, learning-based prediction framework for hardware-accelerated deep neural network (DNN) and non-DNN ML algorithms.

arxiv-2310-05897.title: Tensor Network Based Efficient Quantum Data Loading of Images
arxiv-2310-05897.creator: Jason Iaconis, Sonika Johri
arxiv-2310-05897.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jason Iaconis, Sonika Johri. Image-based data is a popular arena for testing quantum machine learning algorithms. A crucial factor in realizing quantum advantage for these applications is the ability to efficiently represent images as quantum states. Here we present a novel method for creating quantum states that approximately encode images as amplitudes, based on recently proposed techniques that convert matrix product states to quantum circuits.

arxiv-2310-19845.title: Modified Genetic Algorithm for Feature Selection and Hyper Parameter Optimization: Case of XGBoost in Spam Prediction
arxiv-2310-19845.creator: NAZEEH GHATASHEH 1, ISMAIL ALTAHARWA 2 , AND KHALED ALDEBEI. 1
arxiv-2310-19845.description: Abstract Recently, spam on online social networks has attracted attention in the research and business world. Twitter has become the preferred medium to spread spam content. Many research efforts attempted to encounter social networks spam. Twitter brought extra challenges represented by the feature space size, and imbalanced data distributions.

arxiv-2311-08042.title: Quantum Algorithms for Graph Coloring and other Partitioning, Covering, and Packing Problems
arxiv-2311-08042.creator: Serge Gaspers, Jerry Zirui Li
arxiv-2311-08042.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Serge Gaspers, Jerry Zirui Li. Let U U be a universe on n n elements, let k k be a positive integer, and let ℱ \mathcal{F} be a family of (implicitly defined) subsets of U U . We consider the problems of partitioning U U into k k sets from ℱ \mathcal{F} , covering U U with k k sets from ℱ \mathcal{F} , and packing k k non-intersecting sets from ℱ \mathcal{F} into U U .

arxiv-2412-04204.title: PANGAEA: A Global and Inclusive Benchmark for Geospatial Foundation Models
arxiv-2412-04204.creator: Valerio Marsocci, Yuru Jia, Georges Le Bellier, David Kerekes, Liang Zeng, Sebastian Hafner, Sebastian Gerard, Eric Brune, Ritu Yadav, Ali Shibli, Heng Fang, Yifang Ban, Maarten Vergauwen, Nicolas Audebert, Andrea Nascetti
arxiv-2412-04204.description: Abstract Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) have emerged as powerful tools for extracting representations from Earth observation data, but their evaluation remains inconsistent and narrow. Existing works often evaluate on suboptimal downstream datasets and tasks, that are often too easy or too narrow, limiting the usefulness of the evaluations to assess the real-world applicability of GFMs.

arxiv-2502-03830.title: Unveiling the emission properties of three long-period pulsars using FAST
arxiv-2502-03830.creator: H. M. Tedila, D. Li, P. Wang, R. Yuen, J. P. Yuan, N. Wang, Z. G. Wen, S. J. Dang, A. G. Tegegne, R. Rejep, C. C. Miao, FAST Collaboration
arxiv-2502-03830.description: Abstract We detail the emission behaviors of three long-period pulsars detected using the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST) during the CRAFTS survey. Their rotational periods range from 1.83 s to 4.75 s, and the null fractions measure between 28% and 53%. PSR J1945+1211 and PSR J2323+1214 exhibited quasi-periodic nulls, with duration of around 57 seconds.

arxiv-2504-20956.title: The Development of Reflective Practice on a Work-Based Software Engineering Program: A Longitudinal Study
arxiv-2504-20956.creator: Matthew Barr, Syed Waqar Nabi, Oana Andrei
arxiv-2504-20956.description: Abstract This study examines the development of reflective practice among students in an undergraduate work-based Software Engineering program. Using two established models of reflection – Boud et al .’s Model of Reflective Process and Bain et al. ’s 5R Framework for Reflection – we analyse a series of reflective reports submitted by students over four years.

arxiv-2508-08455.title: Kinematic patterns of the enriched gas phase in the Local Group Hestia simulations
arxiv-2508-08455.creator: L. Biaus, S.E. Nuza, C. Scannapieco, F.G. Iza & E. Lozano
arxiv-2508-08455.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by L. Biaus, S.E. Nuza, C. Scannapieco, F.G. Iza & E. Lozano. Observations of intergalactic absorbers in the Local Group suggest the existence of a velocity dipole in the general barycentre–antibarycentre direction which can be interpreted as evidence of a general flow of material towards the group’s centre of mass. In this work, we study the kinematics of gas in the Local Group using one of the high-resolution realisations of the Hestia simulations with a particular focus on the evidence left by different ionic species.

arxiv-2509-16178.title: Asymptotics for the enumeration of commuting matrices over finite fields
arxiv-2509-16178.creator: Kathrin Bringmann, Shane Chern, Johann Franke, Bernhard Heim
arxiv-2509-16178.description: Abstract . We give asymptotic expressions for the number of commuting matrices over finite fields. For this we use product expansions for the corresponding generating functions. In honor of James Lepowsky’s 80-th birthday. 1. Introduction and statement of results Let \mathbb{F}_{p^{r}} be the finite field with p^{r} elements, where p is a prime and r\in\mathbb{N} .

arxiv-2510-25387.title: Instance-Level Composed Image Retrieval
arxiv-2510-25387.creator: Bill Psomas, George Retsinas, Nikos Efthymiadis, Panagiotis Filntisis, Yannis Avrithis, Petros Maragos, Ondrej Chum, Giorgos Tolias, [0.5em] VRG, FEE, Czech Technical University in Prague
arxiv-2510-25387.description: Abstract The progress of composed image retrieval (CIR), a popular research direction in image retrieval, where a combined visual and textual query is used, is held back by the absence of high-quality training and evaluation data. We introduce a new evaluation dataset, i -CIR, which, unlike existing datasets, focuses on an instance-level class definition.

arxiv-2511-16533.title: Distributed MIS Algorithms for Rational Agents using Games Email: nithinprakash9999@gmail.com , shreyas@cse.iitm.ac.in
arxiv-2511-16533.creator: Nithin Salevemula, Shreyas Pai
arxiv-2511-16533.description: Abstract We study the problem of computing a Maximal Independent Set (MIS) in distributed networks, where each node is a rational agent that receives a payoff depending on whether it is included in the MIS. In classical distributed computing, it is typically assumed that nodes follow the prescribed algorithm faithfully.

arxiv-2601-17956.title: Quantum Radar System Using Born-Feynman path integrals approach
arxiv-2601-17956.creator: Kumar Gautam, Akshit Dutta and Kumar Shubham
arxiv-2601-17956.description: Abstract The paper relates to a quantum radar deployment by the Born-Feynman path integrals approach based on quantum dots. The radar system comprises a quantum dot-based entangled photon generator, a transmission module, a delay line, a detection module, and a signal processing unit. The quantum dot-based entangled photon generator produces entangled photon pairs via spontaneous parametric down-conversion or stimulated emission.

pmc-10628304.title: Relapsing Polychondritis following PD-1 Blockade by an Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor
pmc-10628304.creator: Tomoyuki Mutoh, Sonoko Chikamatsu, Takatsuna Sasaki, Hiroto Seino, Kazuhiro Sakamoto, Masataka Kudo
pmc-10628304.description: Immune-related adverse events (irAEs) mimicking rheumatic diseases are observed in 1.5%-22% of patients receiving cancer therapy with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Relapsing polychondritis (RP) is a rare autoimmune disease mainly involving auricle, nose, and airway cartilage inflammation. However, knowledge regarding RP as an irAE is scarce.

pmc-10675005.title: Current Perspectives and Challenges of MAIT Cell-Directed Therapy for Tuberculosis Infection
pmc-10675005.creator: Melissa D Chengalroyen, Marian Loveday, Helen Cox
pmc-10675005.description: Mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells are a distinct population of non-conventional T cells that have been preserved through evolution and possess properties of both innate and adaptive immune cells. They are activated through the recognition of antigens presented by non-polymorphic MR1 proteins or, alternately, can be stimulated by specific cytokines.

pmc-11357559.title: Quality Control of Microscopic Diagnosis of Malaria in Healthcare Facilities and Submicroscopic Infections in Mossendjo, the Department of Niari, the Republic of the Congo
pmc-11357559.creator: Grâce Petula Urielle Fila-Fila, Felix Koukouikila-Koussounda, Fabien Roch Niama, Lauriate Prudencie Bissombolo Madingou, Jordy Exaucé Demboux, Aldi Fred Mandiangou, Stéphane Vembe Mahounga, Ahmed Jordy Doniama, Louis Régis Dossou-Yovo, Prisca Nadine Casimiro, Pembe Issamou Mayengue
pmc-11357559.description: The control and management of malaria are linked to the quality of diagnosis. We sought to estimate the performance of routine microscopy for malaria diagnosis and assess the prevalence of submicroscopic Plasmodium (P.) falciparum infection among febrile patients in two healthcare facilities in Mossendjo, the Republic of the Congo. A cross-sectional study was conducted between January and December 2022.

pmc-11443968.title: A model of dyadic merging interactions explains human drivers’ behavior from control inputs to decisions
pmc-11443968.creator: Olger Siebinga, Arkady Zgonnikov, David A Abbink, Lydia Kavraki
pmc-11443968.description: Safe and socially acceptable interactions with human-driven vehicles are a major challenge in automated driving. A good understanding of the underlying principles of such traffic interactions could help address this challenge. Particularly, accurate driver models could be used to inform automated vehicles in interactions.

pmc-11509532.title: Spectroscopic Properties of TmF3-Doped CaF2 Crystals
pmc-11509532.creator: Carla Schornig, Marius Stef, Gabriel Buse, Maria Poienar, Philippe Veber, Daniel Vizman
pmc-11509532.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, we report the growth and comprehensive spectroscopic analysis of TmF3-doped CaF2 crystals, grown using the vertical Bridgman method. The optical absorption and photoluminescence properties of both trivalent (Tm3+) and divalent (Tm2+) thulium ions were investigated. Optical absorption spectra in the UV-VIS-NIR range reveal characteristic transitions of Tm3+ ions, as well as weaker absorption bands corresponding to Tm2+ ions.

pmc-11569435.title: Global recommendations on adhesion prophylaxis in gynaecological laparoscopic surgery
pmc-11569435.creator: RL De Wilde, A Adlan, P Aquino, S Becker, M Bigozzi, U Catena, J Clark, F Darmawan, J Dubuisson, MA Habana, CK Khoo, PR Koninckx, H Krentel, A Lam, R Lasmar, SM Mansuria, S Mukherjee, O Musigavong, S Ohri, G Pados, MA Pinho de Oliveira, S Puntambekar, B Rabischong, E Saridogan, J Sehouli, F Sendag,
pmc-11569435.description: Adhesions are recognised as one of the most common complications of abdominal surgery; their diagnosis and prevention remains a significant unmet need in surgical therapy, affecting negatively a patient’s quality of life and healthcare budgets. In addition, postoperative pelvic adhesions pose a high risk of reduced fertility in women of childbearing age.

pmc-11690197.title: DAILY MEMORY ISSUES: NATURE, CORRELATES, AND CONSEQUENCES
pmc-11690197.creator: Johanna Hartung, Gizem Hueluer
pmc-11690197.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Memory lapses are common occurrences in daily life; however, little is known about the mechanisms underlying their occurrence. The overarching goal of this project is to understand the nature, correlates, and consequences of memory lapses in everyday life. We conducted an experience-sampling study over ten days with three measurement occasions per day with 325 adults (age = 18 to 36 years). The momentary assessments included measures of memory lapses, working memory (WM) performance, activities, and mood.

pmc-12695485.title: “Who are you going to call?:” Research ethics consultation directors’ perspectives on barriers and facilitators
pmc-12695485.creator: Skye A Miner, Jennifer B McCormick, Holly A Taylor
pmc-12695485.description: Introduction:Research ethics consultation services (RECS) provide important ethical guidance to various entities, including investigators and Institutional Review Boards. Established in the late 1980s and influenced by funding requirements from the National Center for Advancing Translational Science, RECS have evolved to address ethical challenges in research.

pmc-12780439.title: Updated result from the phase 2 PHAROS study: has the sustained efficacy and tolerability of encorafenib plus binimetinib been demonstrated in patients with BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer?
pmc-12780439.creator: Kimio Yonesaka
pmc-12780439.description: d ALK rearrangements. BRAF V600E, the most frequent BRAF mutation, is found in 1–2% of lung adenocarcinomas (3,4). In clinical trials involving patients with advanced melanoma, the combination of BRAF and MEK inhibitors has demonstrated significantly superior antitumor effects compared with BRAF inhibitor monotherapy (5,6).

pmc-12843035.title: First Report of Agroathelia rolfsii Causing White Fruit Rot in Oil Palm Hybrid OxG in Colombia
pmc-12843035.creator: Lina del Mar Angel-Salazar, Leon Franky Zuñiga-Perez, Yuri Adriana Mestizo-Garzón, Cristian Steven Ortega-Soto, Daniela Alejandra Garcia-Ruiz, Hector Camilo Medina-Cárdenas, Jose Luis Padilla, Liseth Estefanía Vargas-Medina, Anuar Morales-Rodríguez, Greicy Andrea Sarria
pmc-12843035.description: Colombia is the Latin American country with the second-largest area planted with OxG hybrid cultivars, covering more than 120,000 hectares Various health problems can affect yield, especially those affecting fruit. Since 2021, white fruit rot has been reported in the northern, central, and southwestern palm-growing areas.

pmc-13091518.title: FAP-targeting peptide-directed nanoprobes enable tumor microenvironment-activatable MR/NIRF imaging of breast cancer primary tumor and lung metastases
pmc-13091518.creator: Chunting Wang, Jingjing Hu, Yuelin Huang, Yanhong Chen, Ling Zhan, Huanhuan Liu, Defan Yao, Dengbin Wang
pmc-13091518.description: Fibroblast activation protein (FAP), a transmembrane serine protease overexpressed in tumor stroma, has emerged as a dual-purpose biomarker for cancer theranostics. Although FAP-targeting molecular imaging enables precise tumor visualization, its application for microenvironment-responsive detection of breast cancer metastases remains unexplored. To address this, we engineered acidic pH-responsive manganese dioxide (MnO2) nanoprobes via FAP-targeting peptide-directed biomimetic mineralization.

pmc-13184883.creator: Hiroaki Osada, Kenji Minatoya, Fumie Takai, Takahide Takeda, Takehiko Matsuo, Yutaka Okita

pmc-13351753.title: Exercise-induced β-hydroxybutyrate contributes to cognitive improvement in aging mice
pmc-13351753.creator: Lian Wang, Liwei Mao, Danlin Zhu, Ke Li, Haoyang Gao, Muge Zhou, Jiabin Wu, Dan Yang, Ze Wang, Wenhong Wang, Yifan Guo, Yingying Xu, Peijie Chen, Weihua Xiao
pmc-13351753.description: Highlights•Aerobic exercise elevated circulating β-hydroxybutyrate (β-HB) levels and improved cognitive performance in aging mice.•Loss of 3-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase 1 (BDH1) impaired endogenous β-HB production and attenuated exercise-induced cognitive benefits.•Exogenous β-HB mimicked exercise effects in wild-type mice but showed limited efficacy in BDH1-deficient mice.

pmc-13547860.title: Underfunded and undervalued: community-based health promotion practitioners’ experiences of Western Australia’s prevention sector
pmc-13547860.creator: Ruth Wallace, Leesa Costello, Elizabeth J Cook
pmc-13547860.description: Prevention is a central policy focus of contemporary health promotion, offering cost-effective strategies to reduce disease burden and improve population well-being. Despite this, Australia allocates a small proportion of its health budget to prevention, with funding models characterized by short-term cycles and competitive tendering.
